blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In the UK, talking about the weather is not a cliché. It is a survival skill. It is how you break the ice in a lift, start a meeting, or fill a quiet moment.

Today you learn the structure "It is + weather." You also learn the words that keep small talk going. "How's the weather?" is safe. "Lovely day" is a classic opener.

In London the rain is normal, so don't complain about it. But a sunny day is special. A sunny day in London changes the mood of the whole office.

items.q: In the UK, talking about the weather is…
items.why: "talking about the weather is not a cliché. It is a survival skill."

items.q: Which structure does the text teach today?
items.why: "Today you learn the structure 'It is + weather.'"

items.q: According to the text, "How's the weather?" is…
options: a way to end a meeting
items.why: "'How's the weather?' is safe."

items.q: What does the text suggest about rain in London?
options: It is a good reason to complain
It is normal, so people expect it
items.why: Inferência: "the rain is normal, so don't complain about it" — todo mundo já espera chuva.

items.q: The author would most likely agree that a sunny day in London is…
options: the same as any other day
a small event that makes people happier
items.why: Inferência: "a sunny day is special" e "changes the mood of the whole office" — dia de sol muda o ânimo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça o colega britânico falando no começo da reunião. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Come in, sit down. Ah, look outside — it's raining again. Of course it is! It's London.

It's a bit cold this morning too, isn't it? I'm freezing. I forgot my umbrella at home, so I was very wet on the way here. Not a good start to the day.

But the app says it will be sunny this afternoon. That's nice. A sunny day is not normal here, so we should be happy. When it's sunny, the whole office feels better.

Okay, before we start, how is everyone? Did you have a good weekend? Was the weather nice where you are?

Right. Let's begin. But please, keep an umbrella near you. In London you always need one.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the weather like now, at the start of the meeting?
options: It is raining and a bit cold
items.why: "it's raining again" e "It's a bit cold this morning too."

items.q: Why was the speaker very wet?
options: He forgot his umbrella at home
items.why: "I forgot my umbrella at home, so I was very wet on the way here."

items.q: What does the app say about the afternoon?
items.why: "the app says it will be sunny this afternoon."

items.q: Why does the speaker say they "should be happy" about sun?
options: Because the meeting will end early
Because a sunny day is not normal there
Because sun is normal in London
items.why: Inferência: "A sunny day is not normal here, so we should be happy" — sol é raro, por isso é bom.

items.q: Why does the speaker ask about the weekend and the weather?
options: To be friendly and break the ice before work
items.why: Inferência: falar do clima e do fim de semana é small talk para quebrar o gelo antes de começar.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Take a jacket, it is very cold today." Cold means…
items.why: Cold = frio, temperatura baixa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "It's ___ today, so bring an umbrella."
items.why: Você leva guarda-chuva quando está chovendo (raining/rain).

items.q: "It's a lovely and sunny day." Sunny means…
options: there is a lot of snow
there is a lot of rain
there is a lot of sun
items.why: Sunny = ensolarado, com bastante sol.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The sky is grey and there is no sun. It is very ___."
items.why: Cloudy = nublado, céu cheio de nuvens.

items.q: "I always keep an umbrella in my bag." An umbrella is…
options: a thing that keeps the rain off you
items.why: Umbrella = guarda-chuva, protege você da chuva.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em conversa e no começo de reuniões. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let me break the ice before we start." To break the ice means to…
items.why: Break the ice = quebrar o gelo, começar uma conversa amigável.

items.q: "Lovely day, isn't it?" This is…
items.why: "Lovely day" é um jeito clássico de começar uma conversa (small talk).

items.q: "It's freezing out there!" This means it is…
items.why: Freezing = gelado, muito frio.

items.q: "How's the weather?" is used to…
items.why: "How's the weather?" é small talk seguro para conversar com qualquer pessoa.

items.q: "Don't complain about the rain — it's normal here." To complain about means to…
options: say you are not happy about something
items.why: Complain about = reclamar de algo, dizer que não está contente.
